tooltip.recyclerbench.summary: Returns %s%% of a tool or armor's ingredients

recyclerbench.configuration.recycling.pr: How long recycling takes, in ticks. 20 ticks is one second.
recyclerbench.configuration.recycling.pl: Play a chainsaw while the bench is grinding an item.
recyclerbench.configuration.recycling.au: Recycle tools and armor by reading their crafting or smithing recipe.
recyclerbench.configuration.recycling.di: Item ids that can never be recycled.
